comment: Outside ::marker boxes (spec 3.6.4), Ahem, marker color = the li's #2060c0, item text in #404040 spans. Symbol markers at 20px/24px lines: Chromium paints disc/circle/square as 5x5 shapes (circle 7x7 with a ring) about 17px left of the li's border box and centred near the middle of the glyph square (y +11 in the line), not as the font's U+2022 glyph. Ordinal markers at 10px: the text plus '. ' ends at the li start ('1.' squares at x 20..40 for a li at 50; 'III.' right-aligned the same way); none draws nothing; list-style-image (icon.svg 24x24) grows the first line box (li 28px tall); a ::marker with font-size 16px and its own color makes the lines 21px tall.
